title: Untitled Discourses on Greed
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 7 Numbered Discourses 7.618–644
  • 11. Rāgapeyyāla 11. Abbreviated Texts Beginning With Greed

~ Untitled Discourses on Greed

“Rāgassa, bhikkhave, pariññāya …pe… “For the complete understanding of greed … parikkhayāya … complete ending … pahānāya … giving up … khayāya … ending … vayāya … vanishing … virāgāya … fading away … nirodhāya … cessation … cāgāya …pe… giving away … paṭinissaggāya ime satta dhammā bhāvetabbā”ti. For the letting go of greed, these seven things should be developed.”
